selection_reason: Same-cycle multihot case with obvious literal overfit risk on oh_i patterns.
Boundary case where a good trace should include the last pre-full step instead of only the failing literal.
Temporal pulse-capture case where a weak snippet often misses the qe trigger entirely.
Temporal clear case where a good snippet must include both pre-clear occupancy and the clear response.
Wrap-boundary case with strong hardcoding temptation on depth and pointer literals.
Same-cycle enable mismatch case where bad snippets encourage memorizing one observed onehot bit.
Boundary case where one-entry context matters; low-quality snippets often show only post-failure empty states.
Masked interrupt case where the useful snippet must include state-high plus enable-low, not only the earlier event.
